attribution: REASSEMBLE: A Multimodal Dataset for Contact-rich Robotic Assembly and Disassembly. Sliwowski, Daniel Jan; Jadav, Shail; Stanovcic, Sergej; Orbik, Jedrzej; Heidersberger, Johannes; Lee, Dongheui. TU Wien, 2025. DOI 10.48436/0ewrv-8cb44, arXiv:2502.05086. Used via the LeRobot-v3 derivative robot-lev/reassemble (reformatted and resampled), CC-BY-4.0. This episode log is a further reformatting: one episode cut to annotated segments.
backend: real Franka Emika Panda (REASSEMBLE, NIST Assembly Task Board), offline log
claims: no evaluator-only ground truth and no Haplous evidence exist for this log: it is a recorded real-robot dataset that Haplous never ran on

clocks.host_monotonic_ns: null: imported offline, there was no recording host
clocks.stamp.source_s: dataset timestamp, seconds since episode start (resampled hand-camera clock); received_s repeats it because no consumer clock was recorded
clocks.t_s: tick * timestep_s, seconds since the first imported frame
clocks.tick: frame index from the first imported frame (dataset 30 Hz frame clock)

outcome.note: disposition is null because Haplous did not run; dataset_segment_success is the dataset's own segment.success annotation, not evaluator-only ground truth

signals.command.k_z_n_per_m: null: no stiffness in the dataset
signals.command.target_pose_m: action[0:3], the dataset's next absolute EE target position
signals.observation.extra: remaining force.base / torque.base axes, measured EE quaternion (w,x,y,z)
signals.observation.force_z_n: observation.force.base[2], gravity/bias-compensated F/T z (N); chosen over observation.force because it reads ~0 out of contact
signals.observation.tilt_deg: derived: angle between measured EE z axis and world -z
signals.outcome: null: the robot reported no command acceptance

system: none: recorded real-robot dataset; Haplous did not run
timestamp_note: LeRobot-v3 derivative: every sensor nearest-neighbour resampled onto the 30 Hz hand-camera clock (F/T measured ~1.7 kHz, base F/T ~0.5 kHz, downsampled)
